versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֥ר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo-lhes:

versos.hebraico: דַּבְּר֛וּ אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֹ֤את הַֽחַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכְל֔וּ מִכָּל־הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
controles.livre: Falai aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Estes são os animais que comereis de todos os animais que estão sobre a terra.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֣ל׀ מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְשֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֨סַע֙ פְּרָסֹ֔ת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.
controles.kjv: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
controles.livre: De entre os animais, todo o de casco, e que tem as unhas fendidas, e que rumina, este comereis.

versos.hebraico: אַ֤ךְ אֶת־זֶה֙ לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ מִֽמַּעֲלֵי֙ הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֖י הַפַּרְסָ֑ה אֶֽת־הַ֠גָּמָל כִּֽי־מַעֲלֵ֨ה גֵרָ֜ה ה֗וּא וּפַרְסָה֙ אֵינֶ֣נּוּ מַפְרִ֔יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because he chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, he is unclean to you.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
controles.livre: Estes, porém, não comereis dos que ruminam e dos que têm casco: o camelo, porque rumina mas não tem casco fendido, haveis de tê-lo por impuro;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַשָּׁפָ֗ן כִּֽי־מַעֲלֵ֤ה גֵרָה֙ ה֔וּא וּפַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַפְרִ֑יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: The cony, because he chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, he is unclean to you.
controles.kjv: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
controles.livre: Também o coelho, porque rumina, mas não tem unha fendida, o tereis por impuro;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הָאַרְנֶ֗בֶת כִּֽי־מַעֲלַ֤ת גֵּרָה֙ הִ֔וא וּפַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֑יסָה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִ֖וא לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: The hare, because she chews the cud but doesn’t part the hoof, she is unclean to you.
controles.kjv: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
controles.livre: Assim a lebre, porque rumina, mas não tem unha fendida, a tereis por impura;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַ֠חֲזִיר כִּֽי־מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֜ה ה֗וּא וְשֹׁסַ֥ע שֶׁ֨סַע֙ פַּרְסָ֔ה וְה֖וּא גֵּרָ֣ה לֹֽא־יִגָּ֑ר טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: The pig, because he has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, he is unclean to you.
controles.kjv: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
controles.livre: Também o porco, porque tem unhas, e é de unhas fendidas, mas não rumina, o tereis por impuro.

versos.hebraico: מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָ֖ם לֹ֣א תִגָּ֑עוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch; they are unclean to you.
controles.kjv: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
controles.livre: Da carne deles não comereis, nem tocareis seu corpo morto: os tereis por impuros.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֩ סְנַפִּ֨יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֜שֶׂת בַּמַּ֗יִם בַּיַּמִּ֛ים וּבַנְּחָלִ֖ים אֹתָ֥ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: “‘These you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.
controles.kjv: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
controles.livre: Isto comereis de todas as coisas que estão nas águas: todas as coisas que têm barbatanas e escamas nas águas do mar, e nos rios, aquelas comereis;

versos.hebraico: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽין־ל֜וֹ סְנַפִּ֣יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֗שֶׂת בַּיַּמִּים֙ וּבַנְּחָלִ֔ים מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הַמַּ֔יִם וּמִכֹּ֛ל נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַחַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,
controles.kjv: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
controles.livre: Mas todas as coisas que não têm barbatanas nem escamas no mar e nos rios, tanto de todo réptil de água como de toda coisa vivente que está nas águas, as tereis em abominação.

versos.hebraico: וְשֶׁ֖קֶץ יִהְי֣וּ לָכֶ֑ם מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְאֶת־נִבְלָתָ֖ם תְּשַׁקֵּֽצוּ׃

controles.web: and you detest them. You shall not eat of their flesh, and you shall detest their carcasses.
controles.kjv: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
controles.livre: Vos serão, pois, em abominação: de sua carne não comereis, e abominareis seus corpos mortos.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters, that is an abomination to you.
controles.kjv: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
controles.livre: Tudo o que não tiver barbatanas e escamas nas águas, o tereis em abominação.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־אֵ֨לֶּה֙ תְּשַׁקְּצ֣וּ מִן־הָע֔וֹף לֹ֥א יֵאָכְל֖וּ שֶׁ֣קֶץ הֵ֑ם אֶת־הַנֶּ֨שֶׁר֙ וְאֶת־הַפֶּ֔רֶס וְאֵ֖ת הָעָזְנִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: “‘These you shall detest among the birds; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the vulture, and the black vulture,
controles.kjv: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
controles.livre: E das aves, estas tereis em abominação; não se comerão, serão abominação: a água, o quebra-ossos, o esmerilhão,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַ֨דָּאָ֔ה וְאֶת־הָאַיָּ֖ה לְמִינָֽהּ׃

controles.web: and the red kite, any kind of black kite,
controles.kjv: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
controles.livre: O milhafre, e o falcão a segundo sua espécie;

versos.hebraico: אֵ֥ת כָּל־עֹרֵ֖ב לְמִינֽוֹ׃

controles.web: any kind of raven,
controles.kjv: Every raven after his kind;
controles.livre: Todo corvo segundo sua espécie;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽיַּעֲנָ֔ה וְאֶת־הַתַּחְמָ֖ס וְאֶת־הַשָּׁ֑חַף וְאֶת־הַנֵּ֖ץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: the horned owl, the screech owl, and the gull, any kind of hawk,
controles.kjv: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
controles.livre: O avestruz, e a coruja, e a gaivota, e o gavião segundo sua espécie;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַכּ֥וֹס וְאֶת־הַשָּׁלָ֖ךְ וְאֶת־הַיַּנְשֽׁוּף׃

controles.web: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
controles.kjv: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
controles.livre: E o mocho, e o corvo-marinho, e o íbis,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַתִּנְשֶׁ֥מֶת וְאֶת־הַקָּאָ֖ת וְאֶת־הָרָחָֽם׃

controles.web: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,
controles.kjv: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
controles.livre: E a galinha-d'água, e o cisne, e o pelicano,

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ הַחֲסִידָ֔ה הָאֲנָפָ֖ה לְמִינָ֑הּ וְאֶת־הַדּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְאֶת־הָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃

controles.web: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.
controles.kjv: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
controles.livre: E a cegonha, e a garça, segundo sua espécie, e a poupa, e o morcego.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֚ל שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־אַרְבַּ֑ע שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
controles.kjv: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
controles.livre: Todo inseto de asas que andar sobre quatro pés, tereis em abominação.

versos.hebraico: אַ֤ךְ אֶת־זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־אַרְבַּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר־לא כְרָעַ֨יִם֙ מִמַּ֣עַל לְרַגְלָ֔יו לְנַתֵּ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have legs above their feet, with which to hop on the earth.
controles.kjv: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
controles.livre: Porém isto comereis de todo inseto de asas que anda sobre quatro patas, que tiver pernas além de suas patas para saltar com elas sobre a terra;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־אֵ֤לֶּה מֵהֶם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אֶת־הָֽאַרְבֶּ֣ה לְמִינ֔וֹ וְאֶת־הַסָּלְעָ֖ם לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת־הַחַרְגֹּ֣ל לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְאֶת־הֶחָגָ֖ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.
controles.kjv: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
controles.livre: Estes comereis deles: o gafanhoto migrador segundo sua espécie, e a esperança segundo sua espécie, e o grilo segundo sua espécie, e o gafanhoto comum segundo sua espécie.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף אֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ אַרְבַּ֣ע רַגְלָ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: But all winged creeping things which have four feet, are an abomination to you.
controles.kjv: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
controles.livre: Todo réptil de asas que tenha quatro pés, tereis em abominação.

versos.hebraico: וּלְאֵ֖לֶּה תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E por estas coisas sereis impuros: qualquer um que tocar a seus corpos mortos, será impuro até à tarde:

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַנֹּשֵׂ֖א מִנִּבְלָתָ֑ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E qualquer um que levar de seus corpos mortos, lavará suas roupas, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: לְֽכָל־הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִוא֩ מַפְרֶ֨סֶת פַּרְסָ֜ה וְשֶׁ֣סַע׀ אֵינֶ֣נָּה שֹׁסַ֗עַת וְגֵרָה֙ אֵינֶ֣נָּה מַעֲלָ֔ה טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִטְמָֽא׃

controles.web: “‘Every animal which parts the hoof, and is not cloven-footed, nor chews the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.
controles.kjv: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
controles.livre: Todo animal de casco, mas que não tem unha fendida, nem rumina, tereis por impuro: qualquer um que os tocar será impuro.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹ֣ל׀ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־כַּפָּ֗יו בְּכָל־הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַהֹלֶ֣כֶת עַל־אַרְבַּ֔ע טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E de todos os animais que andam a quatro patas, tereis por impuro qualquer um que ande sobre suas garras: qualquer um que tocar seus corpos mortos, será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת־נִבְלָתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה לָכֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.
controles.kjv: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
controles.livre: E o que levar seus corpos mortos, lavará suas roupas, e será impuro até à tarde: haveis de tê-los por impuros.

versos.hebraico: וְזֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ הַטָּמֵ֔א בַּשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ הַחֹ֥לֶד וְהָעַכְבָּ֖ר וְהַצָּ֥ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,
controles.kjv: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
controles.livre: E estes tereis por impuros dos répteis que vão arrastando sobre a terra: a doninha, e o rato, e o lagarto segundo sua espécie,

versos.hebraico: וְהָאֲנָקָ֥ה וְהַכֹּ֖חַ וְהַלְּטָאָ֑ה וְהַחֹ֖מֶט וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃

controles.web: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.
controles.kjv: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
controles.livre: E a lagartixa, e o lagarto pintado, e a lagartixa de parede, e a salamandra, e o camaleão.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה הַטְּמֵאִ֥ים לָכֶ֖ם בְּכָל־הַשָּׁ֑רֶץ כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֧עַ בָּהֶ֛ם בְּמֹתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead, shall be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: Estes tereis por impuros de todos os répteis: qualquer um que os tocar, quando estiverem mortos, será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־יִפֹּל־עָלָיו֩ מֵהֶ֨ם׀ בְּמֹתָ֜ם יִטְמָ֗א מִכָּל־כְּלִי־עֵץ֙ א֣וֹ בֶ֤גֶד אוֹ־עוֹר֙ א֣וֹ שָׂ֔ק כָּל־כְּלִ֕י אֲשֶׁר־יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה מְלָאכָ֖ה בָּהֶ֑ם בַּמַּ֧יִם יוּבָ֛א וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעֶ֖רֶב וְטָהֵֽר׃

controles.web: On whatever any of them falls when they are dead, it shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening; then it will be clean.
controles.kjv: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
controles.livre: E tudo aquilo sobre que cair algum deles depois de mortos, será impuro; tanto vaso de madeira, como roupa, ou pele, ou saco, qualquer instrumento com que se faz obra, será posto em água, e será impuro até à tarde, e assim será limpo.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־כְּלִי־חֶ֔רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־יִפֹּ֥ל מֵהֶ֖ם אֶל־תּוֹכ֑וֹ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹכ֛וֹ יִטְמָ֖א וְאֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁבֹּֽרוּ׃

controles.web: Every earthen vessel, into which any of them falls, all that is in it shall be unclean, and you shall break it.
controles.kjv: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
controles.livre: E toda vasilha de barro dentro da qual cair algum deles, tudo o que estiver nela será impuro, e quebrareis a vasilha:

versos.hebraico: מִכָּל־הָאֹ֜כֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָב֥וֹא עָלָ֛יו מַ֖יִם יִטְמָ֑א וְכָל־מַשְׁקֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁתֶ֔ה בְּכָל־כְּלִ֖י יִטְמָֽא׃

controles.web: All food which may be eaten, that on which water comes, shall be unclean; and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
controles.kjv: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
controles.livre: Toda comida que se come, sobre a qual vier a água de tais vasilhas, será imunda: e toda bebida que se beber, será em todas essas vasilhas impura:

versos.hebraico: וְ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִפֹּ֨ל מִנִּבְלָתָ֥ם׀ עָלָיו֮ יִטְמָא֒ תַּנּ֧וּר וְכִירַ֛יִם יֻתָּ֖ץ טְמֵאִ֣ים הֵ֑ם וּטְמֵאִ֖ים יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces: they are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.
controles.kjv: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
controles.livre: E tudo aquilo sobre que cair algo do corpo morto deles, será impuro: o forno ou aquecedores se derrubarão; são impuros, e por impuros os tereis.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ מַעְיָ֥ן וּב֛וֹר מִקְוֵה־מַ֖יִם יִהְיֶ֣ה טָה֑וֹר וְנֹגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָֽא׃

controles.web: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean: but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
controles.livre: Contudo, a fonte e a cisterna onde se recolhem águas, serão limpas: mas o que houver tocado em seus corpos mortos será impuro.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֤י יִפֹּל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔ם עַל־כָּל־זֶ֥רַע זֵר֖וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִזָּרֵ֑עַ טָה֖וֹר הֽוּא׃

controles.web: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
controles.kjv: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
controles.livre: E se cair de seus corpos mortos sobre alguma semente que se haja de semear, será limpa.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֤י יֻתַּן־מַ֨יִם֙ עַל־זֶ֔רַע וְנָפַ֥ל מִנִּבְלָתָ֖ם עָלָ֑יו טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.
controles.kjv: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
controles.livre: Mas se se houver posto água na semente, e cair de seus corpos mortos sobre ela, a tereis por impura.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֤י יָמוּת֙ מִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הִ֥יא לָכֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָ֑ה הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: “‘If any animal, of which you may eat, dies; he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E se algum animal que tiverdes para comer se morrer, o que tocar seu corpo morto será impuro até à tarde:

versos.hebraico: וְהָֽאֹכֵל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת־נִבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E o que comer de seu corpo morto, lavará suas roupas, e será impuro até à tarde: também o que tirar seu corpo morto, lavará suas roupas, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃

controles.web: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
controles.kjv: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
controles.livre: E todo réptil que vai arrastando sobre a terra, é abominação; não se comerá.

versos.hebraico: כֹּל֩ הוֹלֵ֨ךְ עַל־גָּח֜ן וְכֹ֣ל׀ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־אַרְבַּ֗ע עַ֚ד כָּל־מַרְבֵּ֣ה רַגְלַ֔יִם לְכָל־הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּם כִּי־שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵֽם׃

controles.web: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
controles.kjv: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
controles.livre: Tudo o que anda sobre o peito, e tudo o que anda sobre quatro ou mais patas, de todo réptil que anda arrastando sobre a terra, não o comereis, porque é abominação.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תְּשַׁקְּצוּ֙ אֶת־נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֑ץ וְלֹ֤א תִֽטַּמְּאוּ֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְנִטְמֵתֶ֖ם בָּֽם׃

controles.web: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps, neither shall you make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled thereby.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
controles.livre: Não torneis abomináveis vossas pessoas com nenhum réptil que anda arrastando, nem vos contamineis com eles, nem sejais impuros por eles.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם֙ וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָ֑נִי וְלֹ֤א תְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy: neither shall you defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.
controles.kjv: For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
controles.livre: Pois que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, vós portanto vos santificareis, e sereis santos, porque eu sou santo: assim que não torneis abomináveis vossas pessoas com nenhum réptil que andar arrastando sobre a terra.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הַֽמַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָֽנִי׃

controles.web: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
controles.kjv: For I am the Lord that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
controles.livre: Porque eu sou o SENHOR, que vos faço subir da terra do Egito para vos ser por Deus: sereis pois santos, porque eu sou santo.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֤ת הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וְהָע֔וֹף וְכֹל֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה הָרֹמֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם וּלְכָל־נֶ֖פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶ֥צֶת עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,
controles.kjv: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
controles.livre: Esta é a lei dos animais e das aves, e de todo ser vivente que se move nas águas, e de todo animal que anda arrastando sobre a terra;

versos.hebraico: לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַטָּמֵ֖א וּבֵ֣ין הַטָּהֹ֑ר וּבֵ֤ין הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַֽנֶּאֱכֶ֔לֶת וּבֵין֙ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”
controles.kjv: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
controles.livre: Para fazer diferença entre impuro e limpo, e entre os animais que se podem comer e os animais que não se podem comer.
